verdict.rationale: cubic runs its own unattended automation: the GitHub app automatically reviews new PRs without user interaction, and an official CLI (`cubic review`) can review local changes and produce a prompt for a coding agent. However, the evidence never documents running the CLI non-interactively in a CI pipeline, so headless/CI use is only implied. missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration for the CLI, a non-interactive/headless mode with flags or exit codes, CI authentication guidance, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Once installed, cubic automatically reviews new pull requests.
The **cubic CLI** reviews local changes before you push. It finds bugs and generates a prompt that your coding agent can use to fix them.
